title: What Stripe is asked to collect and charge
assertion: The SetupIntent's `allowed_payment_method_types`, the subscription's and the audit invoice's `payment_method_types` each send exactly `['us_bank_account', 'card']`, bank first, from the shared order, whose module imports nothing but types; the subscription saves no default of its own (`'off'`), and a new default clears any subscription's own default so the customer's governs every invoice
noFileReason: The Stripe adapter runs against a mocked SDK client that records each request; no file.
